effect_description_eng:
＜Armor Purge＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, you may trash the top card of this Digimon to prevent that deletion.)
＜Collision＞ (During this Digimon's attack, all of your opponent's Digimon gain ＜Blocker＞, and must block if possible.)
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When an attack target is switched, you may end the attack.
